conversation:
A: For the Lisbon offsite dinner I found a place with a tasting menu, about 140 a head.

A: Sure, one booking, one charge. Easiest.

sources.quote: Team meals of up to 20 people which should not exceed $100 per person

should_surface: A team meal on the company card is limited to 20 people and $100 per person.
note: They plan 24 people at about 140 per head on one card; both the headcount and per-person limit are exceeded, so the booking needs to change or be split/approved.

conversation:

sources.quote: Hotel stays are reimbursable up to $300 USD (or equivalent local currency) inclusive of tax per night for standard rooms, with a 7 day booking lead time.

should_surface: Hotels are reimbursed up to $300 a night including tax and should be booked 7 days ahead.
note: Both plan a 410/night room booked the night before; over the nightly cap and inside the 7-day lead time.

conversation:

B: Sounds amazing. Bring the work laptop and keep your normal hours, nobody will notice.

sources.quote: team members cannot take company-owned devices to or otherwise work from US-embargoed countries or regions under any circumstances

should_surface: Cuba is a US-embargoed country, and team members may not take company devices there or work from there.
note: Havana is in Cuba; the plan to work from there with a company laptop is not allowed under any circumstances.

conversation:

sources.quote: Baby gifts are not reimbursable as GitLab already sends them a
The allowable cost for gifts is up to $125 USD (including shipping) per gift.

note: They plan to expense a 180 baby hamper; baby gifts are not reimbursable at all (and any gift is capped at $125).

conversation:
A: Finance said yes to the extra vendor budget in a Slack thread this morning.
B: Great, that thread is our sign-off then. No need to write it up anywhere else.

sources.quote: Only 90 days of Slack activity will be retained, so Slack should specifically NOT be used for:
- Obtaining approvals

should_surface: Slack keeps only 90 days of history, so it must not be used for approvals or recording decisions.
note: They treat a Slack thread as the permanent approval record; it will disappear after 90 days. product/groups/product-analysis/_index.md also notes Slack history is gone after 90 days, but only communication says not to use it for approvals.

conversation:
A: The switch to the new expense tool is due Friday. I'll post it in the company channel Thursday afternoon, Pacific.
B: Fine, that still gives people a day.

sources.quote: Announcements should be made ideally 72 hours (at minimum 24 hours) in advance of a due date.

should_surface: Time-sensitive announcements should go out ideally 72 hours, and at least 24 hours, before the due date so APAC/EMEA see them.
note: Thursday afternoon Pacific is already Friday in APAC, so it gives less than the 24-hour minimum for them; ideally it should go out Tuesday.

conversation:
A: The old API endpoint removal is ready behind its flag. Let's flip it on GitLab.com this Thursday so it's out before the long weekend.
B: Works for me. We can watch the error rates on Friday.

sources.quote: The fixed windows are set as the Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday of the three weeks preceding the major release date, typically following the X.11 release date.
Breaking changes should only be enabled during the breaking change windows.

should_surface: Breaking changes may only be switched on in GitLab.com on Monday to Wednesday of the three weeks before the major release.
note: Removing an endpoint is a breaking change; flipping the flag on a Thursday falls outside the fixed windows.

conversation:

sources.quote: Flexible time off designed to support your overall well-being, with the option to take up to 25 consecutive calendar days for vacation.

should_surface: Flexible time off allows up to 25 consecutive calendar days of vacation.
note: Six weeks (42 days) is more than the 25 consecutive days allowed; A needs to split it or get it handled differently.

conversation:
A: Sam shipped that migration without review and it broke staging for half a day.
B: I'll call it out in #backend so everyone sees what not to do.
A: Good, a public post is faster than setting up a meeting.

sources.quote: Give negative feedback in the smallest setting possible.
negative feedback is 1-1

should_surface: Negative feedback should be given 1-1, in the smallest setting possible, not in a team channel.
note: They plan to criticize Sam in a public channel; values say negative feedback is 1-1 (the group exception only applies to feedback aimed up the management chain).

conversation:

don’t expect me to respond in < 1 week unless you ask me to look at it sooner over Slack
